_doc: Reply and forward subject prefixes shipped with Mailsense (mail.ShippedPrefixes), any script, matched case-insensitively after NFKC with an optional counter (RE[2]:). wikipedia (generated): the standard prefixes and the RE/FW columns of the language table of the pinned revision. extras (hand-kept): prefixes the page lacks, each with its provenance. Users add more with mail.subject.prefixes; this install learns more into mail.subject.prefixes_learned.
_source: generated by scripts/update-prefixes.sh from the pinned revision of Wikipedia's "List of email subject abbreviations" (prefixes-pin.json); extras are hand-kept

extras.note: Turkish İLT (İlet) as typed with a plain i: case-insensitive matching does not fold İ to i (kept from the previous shipped list)
Simplified Chinese reply prefix written by Outlook (kept from the previous shipped list; the page lists 回复)
Traditional Chinese forward prefix of clients other than Outlook (kept from the previous shipped list; the page lists 轉寄)
